{"predictors": [
{"name": "R&DIntensity", "construction": "Research and Development expenses divided by Sales over the past 3 years, using Compustat data", "rationale": "Firms with high R&D intensity may be more likely to experience future growth and innovation, leading to higher returns. This measure captures a firm's commitment to long-term investment and risk-taking.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "CapitalExpenditureVariance", "construction": "Standard deviation of Capital Expenditures over the past 5 years, using Compustat data", "rationale": "Firms with high variability in capital expenditures may be more likely to experience future growth opportunities or financial distress, leading to higher returns. This measure captures a firm's ability to adapt to changing business conditions.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "EmployeeGrowthRate", "construction": "Compound annual growth rate of Total Employees over the past 5 years, using Compustat data", "rationale": "Firms with high employee growth rates may be more likely to experience future expansion and increasing returns to scale, leading to higher returns. This measure captures a firm's ability to attract and retain talent.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "InventoryTurnoverVariance", "construction": "Standard deviation of Inventory Turnover over the past 5 years, using Compustat data", "rationale": "Firms with high variability in inventory turnover may be more likely to experience future supply chain disruptions or changes in demand, leading to higher returns. This measure captures a firm's ability to manage inventory risk.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "AccountsReceivableDaysVariance", "construction": "Standard deviation of Accounts Receivable Days over the past 5 years, using Compustat data", "rationale": "Firms with high variability in accounts receivable days may be more likely to experience future changes in customer payment behavior or credit risk, leading to higher returns. This measure captures a firm's ability to manage working capital risk.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "AdvertisingIntensity", "construction": "Advertising expenses divided by Sales over the past 3 years, using Compustat data", "rationale": "Firms with high advertising intensity may be more likely to experience future brand recognition and customer loyalty, leading to higher returns. This measure captures a firm's commitment to marketing and customer acquisition.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "DirectorAndOfficerOwnershipVariance", "construction": "Standard deviation of Director and Officer Ownership percentage! over the past 5 years, using proxy statements", "rationale": "Firms with high variability in director and officer ownership may be more likely to experience future changes in management incentives or corporate governance, leading to higher returns. This measure captures a firm's ability to align management interests with shareholder interests.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "PensionFundAssetLiabilityMismatch", "construction": "Difference between Pension Fund Assets and Pension Fund Liabilities as a percentage of Total Assets, using Compustat data", "rationale": "Firms with large pension fund asset-liability mismatches may be more likely to experience future funding shortfalls or excess returns, leading to higher returns. This measure captures a firm's ability to manage pension fund risk.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "ForeignSalesVariance", "construction": "Standard deviation of Foreign Sales as a percentage of Total Sales over the past 5 years, using Compustat data", "rationale": "Firms with high variability in foreign sales may be more likely to experience future changes in global market conditions or exchange rates, leading to higher returns. This measure captures a firm's ability to manage international risk.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "R&DCollaboration", "construction": "Number of R&D collaborations or joint ventures announced over the past 3 years, using news archives", "rationale": "Firms that engage in R&D collaborations may be more likely to experience future innovation and knowledge sharing, leading to higher returns. This measure captures a firm's ability to leverage external knowledge and expertise.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}
]}
